title: Prerequisites
raw_text:
9/30/26, 5:12 AM
Prerequisites

In addition to the SAP business partner, you defined the application rule variants for the MKK app in Customizing for Cross-
Application Components under |}Data Protection » Blocking and Unblocking of Data » Business Partner » Define and Store

Application Rule Variants for EoP Check

In transaction ILM Policies (IRMPOL), you defined residence rules in the ILM policy for the ILM object CA BUPA in audit area

BUPA _DP. In addition, you defined retention rules there for the ILM object CA_BUPA in your own defined audit area. In doing so,
you use the application rule variants that are already defined.

Features

Contract Accounts Receivable and Payable performs numerous analyses on the basis of application-specific object types, such as
the FI-CA document. Some of these analyses determine if open business transactions exist for a business partner. If there are
open business transactions, the business partner is not allowed to be blocked. The system also determines a retention start date
using these specific application objects. In combination with the residence period defined in ILM, the date is determined, starting
from which a business partner can be blocked. A business partner has no open business transactions, if the following conditions

(for example) are fulfilled:

e The business partner has no open items.

e There are no open items, in which the business partner is entered in another role, such as an alternative payer.
e The business partner is not entered in any contract account as an alternative payer.

e There are no open request items for the business partner.

e There are no open (non-cash) security deposits for the business partner.

e There are no active SEPA mandates for the business partner.

You can see all application objects that Contract Accounts Receivable and Payable includes in the check in Customizing for
Contract Accounts Receivable and Payable under |)sTechnical Settings Data Protection » Make Specifications for Customer-
Defined Application Objects “. You can also create your own customer-specific checks in the customer namespace.

i Note

You can access information about the individual application objects and the analyses implemented in them by choosing the
Information button on the detail screen for the application object.

Activities

Choose Check Bus. Partner Can Be Blocked (transaction FPDPR1 in the SAP Easy Access screen under |}*Periodic Processing
For Data Protection 3).

As soon as one of the checks finds that there is an open business transaction for business partner, no further checks are
performed. Only if all checks do not find an open business transaction, then the system determines the retention start, using all

application objects that determine this date.

i Note
